title: Gale Regional Terrain Coverage Expansion Audit

registration_gate.decision: Visualization allowed with explicit scientific caveats; pixel-level CTX co-registration NOT verified.
registration_gate.rationale: HRSC 30m mosaic and USGS 200m DEM are registered to the MOLA areoid global frame, while CTX orbital mosaic contains independent optical orthorectification residual biases. Co-registration is uncertified at fine scale.
